question: Who presided over the Seventh Session of the International Solar Alliance Assembly in New Delhi held in October 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pralhad Joshi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Pralhad Joshi, the Union Minister for Parliamentary Affairs, Coal, and Mines of India, presided over the Seventh Session of the International Solar Alliance (ISA) Assembly held in October 2024 in New Delhi.
 
• The International Solar Alliance (ISA) Assembly serves as a platform for member countries to collaborate on solar energy advancements, policy frameworks, and financial mechanisms.
 
• Major discussions during the seventh session included accelerating solar energy adoption, addressing financing challenges, and achieving global energy transition goals.
 
• India’s leadership in hosting the ISA Assembly highlights its commitment to renewable energy and climate change mitigation strategies.
 
• Pralhad Joshi’s role as chairperson underscores India’s active participation in global renewable energy initiatives and its leadership in solar energy adoption.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Solar Alliance (ISA):**

 
 
• The ISA was launched jointly by India and France during COP21 in Paris in 2015, with the aim of uniting countries rich in solar resources to promote sustainable energy solutions.
 
• Its primary objective is to mobilize $1 trillion in investments by 2030 to accelerate solar energy deployment globally.
 
• The headquarters of ISA is situated in Gurugram, Haryana, India.
 
• Over 100 member countries are part of the ISA, making it one of the largest international coalitions dedicated to renewable energy.
